title: Triumvir rank 80
problem: Only gives Arcane to a bearer that already has Arcane (copied from rank 50).

verified_in_game.result: works as intended: gives Arcane with no Arcane present at the time of the cast (bug itself not observed before the patch)

notes: Fix: S: skip the Arcane test — in patch (byte-verified)

release_notes.intended: After the bearer manually casts a spell, it has a 50% chance to gain Arcane.
release_notes.actual: The game only rolled the chance if the bearer already had Arcane, so it could never grant it.
release_notes.fix: Now the chance applies after every manual cast, whether or not the bearer already has Arcane.
